segments.an5.52:1.1: “Akusalarāsīti, bhikkhave, vadamāno pañca nīvaraṇe [ime pañca nīvaraṇe (sī.)] sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.an5.52:1.2: Kevalo hāyaṃ [hayaṃ (sī.), cāyaṃ (syā. kaṃ.), sāyaṃ (ka.)], bhikkhave, akusalarāsi yadidaṃ pañca nīvaraṇā.
segments.an5.52:1.5: Akusalarāsīti, bhikkhave, vadamāno ime pañca nīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.an5.52:1.6: Kevalo hāyaṃ, bhikkhave, akusalarāsi yadidaṃ pañca nīvaraṇā”ti.
